_comment: IPO lockup expirations — when insiders / early investors can sell, per the company's S-1. A lockup expiry is a real catalyst (supply unlock often pressures the stock). Surfaced in the Ask box and flagged near expiry. Update tranches with the ACTUAL S-1 terms and set confirmed:true once verified; large IPOs often have early-release provisions (partial unlock if price holds) and staggered tranches.

tranches.desc: Possible EARLY release window (90d) — many recent S-1s release a portion if the stock holds above the offer price; CONFIRM terms
Standard 180-day lockup expiry — bulk of insider / early-investor / employee shares become eligible to sell

SPCX.notes: Estimate based on a standard 180-day lockup. CONFIRM against the SpaceX S-1 (lockup section + underwriter early-release provisions). Index forced-buys (S&P/Nasdaq inclusion) are a separate supply event.
